starts up a server. And if I were now to

then you do see that indeed uh we have
some data. We can pretty print it. And
you know, life is good. Nothing is
unexpected. But in reality, your fast

this? And this is a trick that I find to
be quite cute. Uh, what you can actually
do is you can just take these
decorators, you can stack them on top of

that is because, of course, in Python,
when you have a decorator, you can stack
it upon another decorator. No harm, no

is particularly elegant here in terms of
pattern is that you can have maybe more
than one point in the website that needs
to have the exact same functionality.
And it's a lot cleaner to just stack
these decorators on top of each other.
The only thing that this decorator does

whenever something hits that route then
it needs to eventually run this function

which is also why you can stack them.
you could design this web framework in
